name: session-helpers
summary: Session-control helpers: /clear (new session, optional --handoff note), all-or-nothing /profile switching (snapshots every config file, verifies marker, extension list and firewall, rolls back byte-for-byte on any failure, /profile status prints the effective configuration; /profile create writes a user profile), /packages (your own pi packages: search and review here; add and remove only at a terminal, which pins version and sha512 with scripts off), /compaction status and toggles backed by the real effective compaction state (published on globalThis, warned once per session), and a lean-ctx binary preflight.
